name: Nakane Shuu
source:
Vocal Range: Medium-Low
Job: Novelist

A novelist with a mysterious lifestyle who hires Haato to become his "assistant" of some sort. He looks disinterested and emotionless all the time, even when he is actually interested. He likes to treat Haato like his pet.
